name: Mental Leap [Psionic]
body:
You can make amazing jumps.

Prerequisite: Dex 13 or Str 13, Acrobatics 2 ranks.

Benefit: While you maintain psionic focus, you gain a +2 enhancement bonus on Acrobatics checks made to jump. If you have at least 10 ranks in Acrobatics, this bonus increases to +4. Additionally, if you expend your psionic focus, you gain a +10 enhancement bonus on an Acrobatics check made to jump. If you have at least 10 ranks in Acrobatics, this bonus increases to +20.
